design_principles: Preserve raw NASA CSV/XML files unchanged.
Keep each source observation and source channel traceable.
Do not equate measurements with different physical definitions.
Do not convert missing or invalid values to zero.
Keep calibrated channels and derived retrievals distinct unless equivalence is scientifically established.
Do not represent MEDA point observations as per-map-cell measurements.

sol.description: Mars solar day parsed from product identity/metadata.

sclk_s.description: MEDA spacecraft clock value; primary within-product observation key.

lmst.description: Local Mean Solar Time, preserved as source string.

ltst.description: Local True Solar Time, preserved as source string.

utc.description: Only populate after validated SCLK-to-UTC correlation; do not infer from row position.

pressure_pa.policy: Keep the three calibrated Barocap channels separate. Derived pressure may be the canonical summary input when valid. Preserve transducer and measurement mode metadata.

relative_humidity_pct.policy: Preserve A and B independently. Derived RHS missing for Sol 232 in the supplied archive; do not silently impute. If a calibrated fallback is used, mark source_level/channel and keep the fallback explicit. Humidity unit is not stated in the inspected XML; confirm from MEDA documentation before production use.

humidity_sensor_temperature_k.policy: Keep physical sensor channels separate; do not average sensor temperatures without calibration rationale.

air_temperature_k.policy: ATS channels are local temperatures at different locations; preserve all five channels and do not average them into air temperature without sensor-position/interpretation review.

ground_brightness_temperature_k.policy: Brightness temperature; do not relabel as direct surface thermodynamic temperature without qualification.

downward_lw_irradiance_cal_w_m2.policy: Bandpass 6.5–30 μm calibrated channel; retain uncertainty and relevant TIRS flags.

downward_lw_irradiance_derived_w_m2.policy: Derived hemispherical estimate assuming blackbody model and Stefan–Boltzmann emission. Keep separate from calibrated bandpass quantity.

upward_lw_irradiance_derived_w_m2.policy: Derived hemispherical estimate; do not merge with calibrated bandpass value.

upward_sw_irradiance_w_m2.policy: Calibrated source only in supplied collection.

wind_horizontal_speed_derived_m_s.policy: Preferred combined retrieval when valid; preserve BOTH_BOOMS_USED_FOR_RETRIEVAL and ROVER_STILL.

wind_vertical_speed_derived_m_s.policy: Retain separately; do not assume complete coverage.

wind_direction_derived_deg.policy: Circular variable; use circular statistics, not arithmetic mean. Confirm direction convention before interpreting as from/to.

wind_boom1_horizontal_speed_m_s.policy: Keep boom channels independent; retain algorithm stability flag.

wind_boom2_horizontal_speed_m_s.policy: Keep boom channels independent; retain algorithm stability flag.

wind_boom1_direction_deg.policy: Circular variable; keep independent of boom 2.

wind_boom2_direction_deg.policy: Circular variable; keep independent of boom 1.

solar_longitude_deg.policy: Solar geometry metadata; not a local weather measurement.

solar_zenith_angle_deg.policy: Solar geometry metadata; preserve the PDS definition/convention.

rover_position_m2020_topo_m.policy: Coordinates are in M2020_TOPO relative to landing site. Transform to project map CRS before spatial use.

rds_channels.policy: Retain channel-by-channel, mount, gain mode, and native units. Do not combine normal/high-gain channels or label these as dust opacity/concentration without a validated retrieval.

quality.raw_value: Preserve original source value where practical.
quality.normalized_value: Null for empty, non-finite, or documented invalid sentinel values.
rules: Do not treat zero as missing by default.
Map the observed WS sentinel 999999999 to null only after confirming it is the invalid sentinel for the relevant field.
Do not reject extreme wind values solely because they are extreme; inspect quality flags and source documentation.
Do not map all flag values of 1 to good; interpret each flag according to its own definition.
Store missingness reason and source field.

time_and_join_policy.join_rule: Never join products by row number. Exact SCLK matching only when exact and semantically appropriate; otherwise use explicitly defined time bins/as-of matching with a documented tolerance.
time_and_join_policy.utc_rule: Use validated SPICE/PDS SCLK correlation for UTC. Product-level start/stop UTC is not a per-row UTC timestamp.
time_and_join_policy.aggregation: Aggregate each variable from its own valid observations within explicit time windows; report n_valid, n_missing, coverage, first/last observation, and variability.

aggregation_policy.per_sol: Compute per-Sol statistics first, then pooled observation-weighted statistics. Also report equal-Sol-weighted mean where useful; do not replace one with the other.
aggregation_policy.uncertainty: Retain source uncertainty fields; do not synthesize uncertainty where source values are absent.

downstream_usage.routing: Weather Service may provide mission/route-level weather factors. A spatial per-cell weather cost requires a separately justified spatial exposure model; MEDA alone is a point/time series and is not a weather raster.
downstream_usage.eva_consumables: Use validated weather analysis as an explicit modifier; preserve baseline consumables and weather-adjusted values separately.
downstream_usage.frontend: Expose one unified weather profile; do not expose individual Sol selection as a required UI workflow.

known_archive_gaps: Derived RHS Sol 232 absent in the supplied derived archive.
Several uncertainty and housekeeping columns are entirely or mostly empty; retain schema fields but mark unavailable per observation.
No Derived RDS product is present in the supplied selected Derived collection; use calibrated RDS channels only.
